title: valeriana officinalis subsp. collina
intro: Valeriana officinalis subsp. collina, commonly known as a subspecies of valerian, is a type of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is often used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, improve sleep quality, and reduce anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana officinalis subsp. collina are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are believed to be triggered by the presence of bioactive constituents such as valepotriates, isovaleric acid, and valerenic acid. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its therapeutic actions and have been shown to have a positive impact on the nervous system, making it a popular natural remedy for stress relief and sleep disorders.
